publications.title: Region-Based Selective Remeshing for User-Guided Generative 3D Editing
publications.summary: A system for interactive, localized 3D model editing: paint the region you want changed, describe it in one sentence, and only that part gets rebuilt while the rest stays exactly as it was.
highlights: Combines geometry processing, computer vision, and generative AI for user-guided 3D editing
ASMR-3D aligns old and new models, selects the edited region through a three-cue voting scheme, and rebuilds only those parts with a thin blending zone
Unchanged geometry stayed roughly 27× closer to the original than full-model regeneration
User study with 14 participants without prior 3D editing experience: 'excellent' on five of six UEQ scales, all 14 would use and recommend it again

publications.title: LieSpy.ai: Multi-Agent Fake News Detection

highlights: Recognized as "Young IT Talent" by SAI Update
Developed a system combining multiple AI agents for fact-checking and reasoning
